Definition: Paseach, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: The name Paseah appears in three settings: a son of Eshton of Judah, and the ancestor of a family of temple servants who return from exile with Zerubbabel. The third is the father of Jehoiada, who repairs the Old Gate of Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the name Paseah, limper, sits beside builders and returners: God's work is carried by ordinary families, and even a limp does not keep a man out of it.
